commands:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=bfebcc94cb7e50786bd8287682b1082cc66001f4; PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1201; git fetch --quiet origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; test -e "$PORT"; . ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null; python -m esptool --port "$PORT" --baud 115200 chip_id 2>&1 | tee /tmp/c6_chip_probe.log; grep -q 'Detecting chip type... ESP32-C6' /tmp/c6_chip_probe.log; idf.py build; idf.py -p "$PORT" flash; python - <<'PY'
import serial, time, sys
port='/dev/cu.usbmodem1201'
end=time.monotonic()+75
with serial.Serial(port,115200,timeout=0.25) as s:
    try:
        s.dtr=False; s.rts=False
    except Exception:
        pass
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        data=s.readline()
        if data:
            text=data.decode('utf-8','replace').rstrip()
            print(text, flush=True)
PY
